messages:
marta: starting a short thread to lock down the canonical error triggers that should cause Auto-fallback. we need a small, explicit list so runtime and policy engine agree.

kevin: +1. proposal: ERROR_RATE, LATENCY_SPIKE, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION, TOKEN_OVERRUN, MODEL_OOM, DEPENDENCY_503. each can have window + threshold. e.g. ERROR_RATE > 2% over 1m or >10% over 10s.

henry: telemetry note: each decision must emit fallback.decision with tags {route, team, model, trigger, severity, policy_hash}. include numeric trigger_value for thresholds.

lex: privacy guardrail: do NOT log raw prompt. only log prompt_hash, token_count, and anonymized token_stats. if customer opt-in & legal allows, store the raw payload in a customer-owned encrypted blob (KMS) referenced by policy_hash.

marta: concrete API the runtime will call (internal): POST /internal/rollouts/{id}/evaluate-fallback with body {context_id, metrics_snapshot}. returns {decision: "continue" | "fallback", triggers: ["ERROR_RATE"], decision_id, policy_snapshot_hash}. decision_id is used to correlate logs.

kevin: should evaluate-fallback be synchronous? latency budget for hot path is tight. maybe allow a "fast" mode that only uses precomputed signals and a "full" mode for controller jobs.

henry: fast mode = use stream counters + cached policy. full mode = evaluate additional heuristics (e.g., per-customer KV cache hit-ratio). fast mode must still emit a sampled fallback.debug event.

lex: sampling strategy: record 100% compact metadata for all fallback.decision events, but only sample full diagnostic payloads at 1% by default. when policy changes, ramp to 100% for 30m for forensic analysis.

marta: UI idea: in rollout timeline show a compact badge "fallback fired (ERROR_RATE)". clicking opens an audit panel with: decision_id, policy_snapshot, small histogram of trigger_metric, and a "simulate alternate policy" button to replay.

kevin: audit retention: keep full diagnostic blobs 90 days, keep compact metadata 2 years. allow export to customer for compliance.

henry: we also need canonical reason codes for telemetry and RBAC filters: LATENCY_SPIKE, ERROR_RATE, TOKEN_OVERRUN, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE, SAFETY_BLOCK. keep them stable strings.

marta: sample event payload (for docs and event schema):
```json
{
  "event": "fallback.decision",
  "route": "payments-api",
  "decision": "fallback",
  "trigger": "ERROR_RATE",
  "trigger_value": 0.087,
  "policy_hash": "f1e2d3a4",
  "decision_id": "dec-20251101-0001",
  "context_id": "req-7a8b9c",
  "prompt_hash": "sha256:...",
  "notes": "sampled-diagnostics: yes"
}
```

lex: small API/security point: require X-Request-ID + X-Rollout-Context headers for evaluate-fallback calls and surface them in audits. they help tie runtime traces to decisions.

kevin: implementation question: who owns the policy_hash -> snapshot store? infra or rollout-service? my vote: rollout-service owns snapshots as immutable blobs, infra can read by hash (rbac enforced).

henry: agree. also add a compact policy diff in the audit (list of active triggers and thresholds) rather than the whole proto, for quick UI rendering. full proto available via link.

marta: does anyone object to the idea that fallback decisions are immutable once emitted? we should never retroactively change a decision. corrections only via new events (e.g., decision.override).

lex: immutability = good. but we need an operator override flow that emits decision.override with actor and reason. keep both events.

ops-bot: created incident #fallback-spike-1788889999 for route payments-api (auto-detected ERROR_RATE).

kevin: next steps: I'll open two PRs - one for event schema + sampling rules, one for the internal evaluate-fallback API contract and header requirements.

marta: i'll add the UI mock for the audit panel and a short spec for the simulate button (replay uses previous context + candidate policy).

henry: i'll wire telemetry emitters and ensure metric names: fallback.decision.counter, fallback.decision.latency_ms_hist, fallback.sampled_diagnostics.size_bytes.

marta: perfect. filing follow-up doc: https://redwood.internal/eng/rollouts/fallback-trigger-spec (will link PRs). thanks everyone.
